page.overview:
Who is Black Heat?

Black Heat is a member of the Super Car Patrol Team. He is presumably childlike and precocious and suchlike.

He also has a phallic black gun, which... along with his name. Actually, how about we don't go there?

He’s usually not thrilled with surprise attacks as well.

Black Heat and every other Micromasters at the Zone Base were defending the Decepticons latest attack on the base as Overlord jumped over him he and Gingham ran for their lives as Overlord stole the Energon Z. Moonradar ordered the Autobots to get in the rocket to follow the Decepticons. The Autobots chased the Decepticon and eventually landed on earth and was losing the battle until Dai Atlas came to save the day.
